alt: Fax cover sheet for an expedited review appeal.
summary: This document is a fax cover sheet for an expedited review request and supplemental appeal submitted to the California Department of Managed Health Care. The appeal concerns an active and unresolved access-to-care failure related to an interrupted benzodiazepine taper and severe withdrawal risk for enrollee Nicolas Hernandez. It requests urgent attention and direct routing to the Expedited Review Unit.
